lines.zh: 双翼收拢，在礁石上笨拙前行
lines.en: Wings folded, I waddle over the rocks.

lines.zh: 趾爪扣住湿沙，一步一步试探
lines.en: Claws testing the wet sand with each step.

lines.zh: 沿着海岸线慢慢踱，头左右摆
lines.en: Pacing the shoreline, head swinging side to side.

lines.zh: 落地后走路摇晃，像踩不稳的船
lines.en: On land I wobble like a rocking boat.

lines.zh: 稀疏的脚印留在潮水边
lines.en: My footprints trail along the tide line.

lines.zh: 走过岩缝，长冠在风里轻晃
lines.en: Passing the crevice, my crest sways in the wind.

lines.zh: 短腿迈不开，走两步就拍一下翅
lines.en: Stubby legs, so I flap once every two steps.

lines.zh: 逆着海风走，翅膀微微张开
lines.en: Walking into the sea wind, wings half open.

lines.zh: 我在浅滩踱步，眼里盯着水面
lines.en: I pace the shallows, eyes fixed on the water.

lines.zh: 从崖脚走过，影子扫过沙滩
lines.en: Crossing the cliff base, my shadow sweeps the beach.

lines.zh: 走路时尾椎左右摆，保持平衡
lines.en: My tail sways as I walk to keep balance.

lines.zh: 身体前倾，扑腾着挪向水边
lines.en: Leaning forward, I flap my way toward the water.

lines.zh: 踩着碎石走，发出细碎的响声
lines.en: Stepping on gravel, I make small clicking sounds.

lines.zh: 我不爱走，可礁石离水只有几步
lines.en: I hate walking, but the surf is only steps away.

lines.zh: 停在崖顶，任海风吹乱翼膜
lines.en: Perched on the cliff, letting the sea wind ruffle my membrane.

lines.zh: 头一动不动，只用眼睛扫海面
lines.en: Head still, only my eyes combing the water.

lines.zh: 我盯着浪花，等鱼群浮上来
lines.en: Watching the breakers, waiting for fish to rise.

lines.zh: 冠向后伸着，像一面小旗
lines.en: My crest points back like a little banner.

lines.zh: 我张开喙，让风从中间穿过
lines.en: I open my beak and let the wind pass through.

lines.zh: 利爪收在身下，静静蹲着
lines.en: Talons tucked beneath me, I squat in silence.

lines.zh: 喙尖无齿，正好夹紧滑鱼
lines.en: A toothless beak, perfect for clamping slippery fish.

lines.zh: 远处有鱼跃起，我却没有动
lines.en: A fish leaps far off; I do not move.

lines.zh: 海雾打湿了翼边，我甩了甩
lines.en: Sea mist dampens my wing edges; I shake them.

lines.zh: 空中的气流变了，我抬了下头
lines.en: The air current shifts; I lift my head.

lines.zh: 我在风里定住，像挂在半空
lines.en: I hang in the wind as if pinned to the sky.

lines.zh: 翅骨轻得能听见风灌进去
lines.en: My wing bones are so hollow I hear wind pour through.

lines.zh: 老翼膜上补着几道旧裂口
lines.en: Old tears are patched across my wing membrane.

lines.zh: 我侧头，用一只眼锁住礁下的水
lines.en: Tilting my head, one eye pins the water below the rocks.

lines.zh: 我把长喙转向你，眼睛漆黑
lines.en: I turn my long beak on you, eyes like black glass.

lines.zh: 你比一条鱼大太多，我先打量
lines.en: You are far bigger than a fish, so I look you over first.

lines.zh: 我歪头，算你算不算猎物
lines.en: I tilt my head, deciding whether you count as prey.

lines.zh: 我盯着你手里的东西，不是你的脸
lines.en: I stare at what you hold, not your face.

lines.zh: 羽冠后掠，我压低姿态看过来
lines.en: Crest swept back, I lower my stance and stare.

lines.zh: 海风把你的气味送过来，我记住了
lines.en: The wind brings your scent; I memorize it.

lines.zh: 我拍了下翅，却没有飞，只看着你
lines.en: One wingbeat, but I stay, just watching you.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的影子了，我抬头
lines.en: You stepped on my shadow; I look up.

lines.zh: 我离地半米，悬着看你
lines.en: I hover half a meter up and study you.

lines.zh: 我们之间的沙地被风刮得发亮
lines.en: The sand between us gleams under the wind.

lines.zh: 我只是好奇，这岛上不常有你这样的
lines.en: Curiosity only, your kind is rare on this islet.

lines.zh: 我侧身让开一条路，眼睛没离开
lines.en: I shift aside to clear a path, eyes never leaving.

lines.zh: 我疼得拍翅，沙都扬起来
lines.en: Pain makes me beat my wings and kick up sand.

lines.zh: 这一下打歪了我的冠
lines.en: That blow knocks my crest crooked.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，声音都劈了
lines.en: I cry out, my voice cracking.

lines.zh: 翼膜一抖，我差点站不住
lines.en: My wing membrane shudders; I nearly fall.

lines.zh: 我退开几步，翅膀半张护着身
lines.en: I back off, wings half spread to guard myself.

lines.zh: 骨头轻，疼得也透
lines.en: Light bones, so the pain goes right through.

lines.zh: 我低头看了看伤口，又抬头
lines.en: I glance at the wound, then look up again.

lines.zh: 血滴在沙上，很快被吸进去
lines.en: Blood drips on the sand and soaks in fast.

lines.zh: 我踉跄了一下，才重新站稳
lines.en: I stumble once before steadying.

lines.zh: 别以为飞走的我记不住这一下
lines.en: Do not think the one who flies off forgets this.

lines.zh: 一条鱼的气味，我整只都转过来
lines.en: The smell of fish turns my whole body.

lines.zh: 我压低翅膀，凑近那条生鱼
lines.en: Wings low, I edge toward the raw fish.

lines.zh: 喙一张一合，口水快滴下来
lines.en: My beak snaps open and shut; I am nearly drooling.

lines.zh: 我围着你手里的鱼打圈
lines.en: I circle the fish in your hand.

lines.zh: 别晃，我盯不住这么快的动作
lines.en: Hold still, I cannot track that fast.

lines.zh: 鱼腥味顺着风钻进鼻孔，我来了
lines.en: Fish scent rides the wind into my nostrils; I am coming.

lines.zh: 我伸长脖子，喙尖快碰到鱼
lines.en: Neck stretched, my beak tip nearly touches the fish.

lines.zh: 我发出短促的叫声，像在讨要
lines.en: I give a short cry, almost begging.

lines.zh: 翅膀半张，随时准备抢
lines.en: Wings half spread, ready to snatch.

lines.zh: 这一口下去，你手可别怪
lines.en: One bite, and do not blame your hand.

lines.zh: 我被你撞得侧翻，翅膀乱拍
lines.en: Knocked sideways by you, my wings beat wildly.

lines.zh: 喙撞上你的肩，硬得像木头
lines.en: My beak hits your shoulder, hard as wood.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我退开半步
lines.en: We collide, and I give half a step back.

lines.zh: 我的翼尖刮到你，骨节咔了一声
lines.en: My wingtip scrapes you; a joint clicks.

lines.zh: 撞得我冠都歪了，我甩甩头
lines.en: The bump knocks my crest askew; I shake my head.

lines.zh: 地上的沙被我们踩起一团
lines.en: Sand puffs up beneath our feet.

lines.zh: 我撞过来时收不住，太轻了
lines.en: I cannot brake on impact, too light to stop.

lines.zh: 你比我稳，我只能拍翅找平衡
lines.en: You are steadier; I flap to find my balance.

lines.zh: 骨头中空的躯体，撞一下就晃
lines.en: A body of hollow bone rocks at a single bump.

lines.zh: 我退到礁石后，警惕地看你
lines.en: I back behind the rock and watch you warily.

lines.zh: 我把长冠抬起，向你展示弧度
lines.en: I raise my long crest to show its curve.

lines.zh: 我拍翅绕圈，翼影在你身上扫过
lines.en: I circle with beating wings, my shadow crossing you.

lines.zh: 巢在崖壁上，我带你去看
lines.en: The nest is on the cliff wall; I lead you there.

lines.zh: 我们头颈相交，喙轻轻碰着
lines.en: We cross necks, beaks touching lightly.

lines.zh: 我衔来干海草，铺在巢里
lines.en: I carry dry seaweed to line the nest.

lines.zh: 风很大，我们靠得很近
lines.en: The wind is strong, so we stand close.

lines.zh: 我低声叫，声音比平时软
lines.en: I call softly, gentler than usual.

lines.zh: 你替我理翼膜，我闭上眼睛
lines.en: You groom my wing membrane; I close my eyes.

lines.zh: 我们的影子在崖上叠成一片
lines.en: Our shadows merge on the cliff face.

lines.zh: 这一窝蛋，得靠我们轮流守
lines.en: These eggs will need us taking turns to guard.

lines.zh: 我叼起鱼，仰头一口吞下
lines.en: I snatch the fish and swallow it down.

lines.zh: 我用喙夹住那块肉，甩了甩
lines.en: I clamp the meat and shake it once.

lines.zh: 这东西太沉，我拖了两步
lines.en: Too heavy, so I drag it two steps.

lines.zh: 我捡起亮晶晶的小物件，看错了
lines.en: I pick up something shiny, mistaking it for a fish.

lines.zh: 我把骨头叼到巢边放着
lines.en: I carry the bone to the nest and set it down.

lines.zh: 喙一合，东西就没了踪影
lines.en: One snap of my beak and it vanishes.

lines.zh: 叼着它我飞不起来，只好放下
lines.en: With that in my beak I cannot lift off, so I drop it.

lines.zh: 我把猎物甩上半空，再接下来
lines.en: I toss the catch up and catch it again.

lines.zh: 我低头闻了闻，才决定收下
lines.en: I sniff it first before accepting.

lines.zh: 爪子按住，喙一点点撕开
lines.en: Talons pin it while my beak tears it open.

lines.zh: 水面一晃，我锁住了那条鱼
lines.en: A ripple, and I have locked on to that fish.

lines.zh: 你的动作太突然，我把你当成威胁
lines.en: Too sudden a move; I mark you as a threat.

lines.zh: 我头一低，目光钉在你身上
lines.en: Head down, my gaze nails you.

lines.zh: 风向对了，你的位置暴露了
lines.en: The wind is right; your position is exposed.

lines.zh: 我张开翅，做出俯冲的准备
lines.en: I spread my wings, ready to dive.

lines.zh: 目标不大，够我一口的
lines.en: The target is small, one mouthful.

lines.zh: 我从崖上看到了它，立刻俯冲
lines.en: From the cliff I spot it and dive at once.

lines.zh: 你在动，我跟着动，眼睛没眨
lines.en: You move, I move, eyes unblinking.

lines.zh: 那条鱼浮上来了，就是现在
lines.en: The fish surfaces, now.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里发出低低的鸣叫
lines.en: A low cry rises in my throat.

lines.zh: 我把你圈进视线中心，不再看别处
lines.en: I center you in my sight and ignore the rest.

lines.zh: 影子先落到你身上，我随后到
lines.en: My shadow lands on you first; I follow.

lines.zh: 这不是鱼，但有东西在动
lines.en: Not a fish, but something is moving.

lines.zh: 我决定了，就它
lines.en: Decided, that one.

lines.zh: 我在你头顶绕，一圈比一圈低
lines.en: I circle overhead, lower each pass.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的脚步，翼影不移
lines.en: I track your steps, my shadow never shifting.

lines.zh: 你在礁石间躲，我从上面盯着
lines.en: You hide among the rocks; I watch from above.

lines.zh: 我算着距离，等一个失手
lines.en: I measure the distance, waiting for one slip.

lines.zh: 翅膀不动，我在气流里滑
lines.en: Wings still, I glide on the current.

lines.zh: 你回头了，我没有退
lines.en: You look back; I do not retreat.

lines.zh: 我压低声音叫，像在催你动
lines.en: I call low, as if urging you to move.

lines.zh: 海风帮你藏气味，可我还看得见
lines.en: The wind hides your scent, but I can still see you.

lines.zh: 我绕着那圈黑影，不急着下手
lines.en: I circle that dark shape, in no hurry.

lines.zh: 我的影子一次次从你脚边滑过
lines.en: My shadow slides past your feet again and again.

lines.zh: 喙尖朝下，我随时能扎下来
lines.en: Beak tipped down, I could strike any moment.

lines.zh: 那条鱼游向深处，我跟着爬升
lines.en: The fish dives; I climb with it.

lines.zh: 你没有跑，这让我更谨慎
lines.en: You are not running, which makes me warier.

lines.zh: 我数着你的步数，找空档
lines.en: I count your steps, hunting for a gap.

lines.zh: 风忽然停了，我们都愣了一下
lines.en: The wind dies, and we both freeze for an instant.

lines.zh: 喙像矛一样刺下来
lines.en: My beak stabs down like a spear.

lines.zh: 我俯冲掠过，翼尖划开空气
lines.en: I dive past, wingtip splitting the air.

lines.zh: 喙夹住它，我仰头往两边甩。
lines.en: My beak clamps down and I jerk my head side to side.

lines.zh: 爪子先落下，扣住再啄
lines.en: Talons land first, pinning before the peck.

lines.zh: 我从侧后扑来，没给你反应
lines.en: I come from behind, leaving no time to react.

lines.zh: 长喙横扫，把你掀开半步
lines.en: A sweep of my long beak shoves you back.

lines.zh: 这一击用了全身的冲力
lines.en: That strike carries my whole dive.

lines.zh: 翅膜扑的一声，我撞了上去
lines.en: A snap of wing membrane, and I slam into you.

lines.zh: 我又升起，准备第二次俯冲
lines.en: I rise again for a second dive.

lines.zh: 我只啄了一下，就滑开
lines.en: One peck, and I veer away.

lines.zh: 海边全是我的节奏，你踩乱了
lines.en: The shore keeps my rhythm; you break yours.

lines.zh: 我把你逼到岩壁，没退路了
lines.en: I press you to the rock wall, no retreat.

lines.zh: 喉咙里的鸣叫变成了尖啸
lines.en: My throaty call sharpens into a shriek.

lines.zh: 打完我就拉开，飞行是我的本行
lines.en: I strike and pull away, for flight is my trade.

lines.zh: 崖顶的风忽然大起来，我落下了
lines.en: The wind on the cliff swells, and I come down.

lines.zh: 我从海雾里钻出，翼展先到
lines.en: I break out of the sea mist, wingspan first.

lines.zh: 一道影子掠过浪面，是我
lines.en: A shadow sweeps the waves; that is me.

lines.zh: 我在礁石上落脚，收起双翼
lines.en: I land on the rock and fold my wings.

lines.zh: 咸味的风里多了一种气息
lines.en: A new scent joins the salty wind.

lines.zh: 高空传来一声尖鸣
lines.en: A shriek sounds from high above.

lines.zh: 我先看见了你，你还没看见我
lines.en: I see you before you see me.

lines.zh: 潮水退去，沙洲露出来，我来了
lines.en: The tide draws back, the sandbar shows, and I arrive.

lines.zh: 我盘旋着找落脚的地方
lines.en: I circle, looking for a perch.

lines.zh: 翼膜兜住风，我停在半空
lines.en: My membrane cups the wind; I hang midair.

lines.zh: 这片海岸我记得，鱼很多
lines.en: I remember this coast, plenty of fish.

lines.zh: 我低低掠过水面，带起一道浪
lines.en: I skim the surface, raising a line of spray.

lines.zh: 长冠在逆光里像一根骨刺
lines.en: Backlit, my crest looks like a bone spike.

lines.zh: 我在崖边站定，把海面扫了一遍
lines.en: I settle at the cliff edge and scan the water.

lines.zh: 又一个从天上来的家伙，是我
lines.en: Another one from the sky, and it is me.

lines.zh: 我的叫声压过了浪声
lines.en: My cry rises over the surf.

lines.zh: 岩石还热着，我先占住最高处
lines.en: The rock is still warm; I take the highest point.

lines.zh: 天与海之间，多了一副翅膀
lines.en: Between sky and sea, one more pair of wings.

lines.zh: 火苗舔到翼膜，我尖叫着窜高
lines.en: Flame licks my wing membrane; I shriek and bolt upward.

lines.zh: 我从半空摔下来，骨头硌得生疼
lines.en: I drop out of the air, my hollow bones throbbing.

lines.zh: 水灌进喙里，我拼命往上蹬
lines.en: Water pours into my beak; I kick desperately upward.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀翻，翼全乱了
lines.en: The blast flips me over, wings in chaos.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉进翼根，我歪着飞
lines.en: An arrow sticks at my wing base; I fly crooked.

lines.zh: 有什么东西烧着我的骨头，看不见火
lines.en: Something burns inside my bones without flame.

lines.zh: 海面空空的，我饿得翅膀发沉
lines.en: The sea is empty; hunger weighs my wings down.

lines.zh: 雷顺着湿翼膜走遍全身
lines.en: Lightning runs down my wet wing membrane.

lines.zh: 脚下没有海了，只有空
lines.en: No sea beneath me now, only nothing.
